title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Conrad Punta del Este Resort & Casino, Punta del Este | 2013
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Conrad Punta del Este Resort & Casino in Punta del Este, Uruguay, on 2 November 2013.

It was the 16th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s 2013 tour, which lasted for 28 dates between February and November.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion

  • ‘I Saw The Light’ (Todd Rundgren)
  • ‘Evil Ways’ (Gregg Rolie)

  • ‘Photograph’

  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
